 "description": "Offers students an opportunity to attend several performances of the Boston Symphony Orchestra (BSO) at Symphony Hall. Analyzes program pieces in order to provide a deeper appreciation for their musical construction; however, no musical background is required to participate in this course—it is designed for nonmusic majors and music majors alike.
